title: Glenn Gaffney named as a leader of the legacy program
place_text: CIA Directorate of Science and Technology

tellings.quote: a lot of people name Glenn Gaffne who's the director of science and technology there as being respon you know one of the last leaders of the legacy program.

plain: Glenn Gaffney, who ran the science and technology branch of the CIA, the US spy agency, is said to have been one of the last leaders of the "legacy program", a supposed secret effort to hold and study crashed craft that are not of human make. Michels says this himself, telling it as something that "a lot of people" say, without naming them. If true, it would put a senior intelligence official at the head of that work.
